Panchami Garden is a good option for a quick, affordable meal. The food tastes good, though not exceptional, and the menu is quite extensive, offering a mix of North Indian and Chinese dishes.

The North Indian meal is a must-try and offers a satisfying option. The restaurant follows a self-service model, and there is plenty of parking available right in front, which is convenient.

However, the place can get quite chaotic during peak hours when there are a lot of people. My main disappointment was the rude behaviour of the kitchen staff who prepare and hand over the food at the counter. A little courtesy and better customer handling would significantly improve the experience.

Overall, good food, a wide menu and convenient parking, but service etiquette needs improvement. Four stars for the food and value, with one star lost due to the staff's behaviour.
